recovery_credit_policy: Every plasma joule is debited on source injection. Acoustic-array recovery is debited from outgoing sound; direct wall recovery is debited as velocity-dependent damping work from the bubble ODE. Only energy collected from these two disjoint paths and rectified for the power manager can be credited, without double counting. No potential or pending plasma energy is credited.

cumulative_accounting.model_warning: uncalibrated coupled wall-impedance harvester plus separate radiative receiver; no resolved structural/electrode dynamics, plasma MHD, acoustic FEM, shocks or measured energy return
cumulative_accounting.stage: externally funded plasma + finite-energy compression + coupled wall harvesting + radiated sound recovery
cumulative_accounting.recovery_limit_reason: The wall harvester removes energy by damping the modeled bubble motion; the acoustic array collects a disjoint part of remaining sound. Both are bounded by externally funded pulse energy and cannot offset upstream converter dissipation in a closed loop.

wall_harvester.caveat: Lumped passive pressure/velocity impedance proxy; mechanical coupling, coverage, and transducer efficiencies are unmeasured. Does not resolve a realizable membrane, plasma MHD or an acoustic shock.

cumulative_break_even_policy: Net break-even occurs only when total useful delivery plus net storage change exceeds all historical source energy. Idle accumulation cannot erase proportional converter losses. Ideal 100% pulse recapture is an upper bound, not a physical prediction.
